context_purpose: A peer marketplace and its buyers want a quick signal that a seller is reliable before a second-hand deal.

norm_violation_today.reason: Public sales history is a normal marketplace convention, but buyers learning home, hobbies and finances from item titles and reviews goes beyond the trust purpose.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Buyers lose the ability to read review text and spot patterns in what was sold; a threshold badge cannot show recency or dispute detail.

transmission_check.reason: No legal duty requires exposing the history, and the platform can already show an aggregate badge itself.

context_purpose: The hospital must confirm that the person signing consent is the patient's designated proxy before a non-emergency procedure.

norm_violation_today.reason: Household-wide register extracts and advance-directive text go well beyond the single fact that this person is the named proxy.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Staff cannot read the scope or conditions of the directive itself, and signed paper consent still has to be kept for legal weight.

transmission_check.reason: Medical consent rules likely require retained signed forms, but I cannot say whether copies of register extracts are mandated.

context_purpose: A building management committee must show it ran a valid, one-unit-one-vote decision that can survive a legal challenge.

norm_violation_today.reason: Signed name-linked ballots are the expected procedure for such resolutions, so the harm is social pressure rather than a clear norm breach.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: If bylaws demand signed ballots, an anonymous nullifier record cannot meet that formal requirement and could weaken evidence in court.

transmission_check.reason: Statute and bylaws appear written around open signed votes and retained minutes, but I cannot confirm the exact requirement.

context_purpose: A private foundation wants to confirm an applicant holds indigenous status and is the real person applying, to award a study grant fairly.

norm_violation_today.reason: Collecting full register scans with parents' details and address stores far more than the status fact the grant needs.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Little lost, except any manual review of edge cases such as status disputes or guardians applying for a minor.

transmission_check.reason: The applicant voluntarily supplies documents for a grant and the foundation has no statutory duty to keep scans.

context_purpose: A funeral home must confirm the signer has kin priority to arrange the handling of the body.

norm_violation_today.reason: Cause of death and insurance details in the bundle are not needed by the funeral home to confirm who may sign.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: The funeral home cannot independently confirm the fact of death unless a separate hospital attestation is also presented.

transmission_check.reason: Handover and burial paperwork rules may require specific documents, and I cannot say whether the full certificate is mandatory at the funeral home.

context_purpose: A bank must confirm that an agent is authorised by a rightful heir before releasing a share of a deceased person's account.

norm_violation_today.reason: Banks handling estate releases legitimately need identity and heirship evidence, so the whole-family tree and ID copy may be partly justified.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: The bank cannot verify the full heir set or detect competing claimants from a single share-floor predicate.

transmission_check.reason: Bank AML and estate-release practice likely requires retained ID copies and heirship documents, and the proof cannot replace them without regulator acceptance.

context_purpose: A university library wants assurance that a visiting student has no overdue or lost items before granting a reader pass.

norm_violation_today.reason: A printed loan history with titles exposes a minor's reading interests when only a clear-standing status is needed.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Nothing material; a one-line librarian letter already conveys the same status.

transmission_check.reason: The pass is a courtesy with no legal duty to receive the loan history.

context_purpose: An ICU ward limits access to authorised visitors to protect patients and staff.

norm_violation_today.reason: A full household transcript reveals every member's details when the desk only needs to confirm one visitor's relationship.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Almost nothing; a membership check plus a pass/fail stamp serves access control, though emergency verbal admission is lost.

transmission_check.reason: Hospital visitor policy is internal, so a lighter proof or a look-without-copying rule is likely acceptable.
